# Introduction

A notebook for the figures used in the TFXcan paper. Many of these analysis were done in other notebooks and the results saved in the `data` folder. The aim of this notebook is to do a few analysis as possible and focus on the figures.

::: {.callout-note}
## Software and packages for this notebook
If you can use conda to create an R environment, that would be best. Otherwise, you are free to install package your preferred way.
Here is an environment yaml file you can use: `https://uchicago.box.com/shared/static/0qxuj0384k51ip54jv5pr5xj20t2kx2i.yaml`
Run the following:

1. conda env create --file ./r-env.yaml --name r-env #or a name you want

2. conda activate r-env

3. r #or R or radian
:::

# Setup

This section collects everything that used to be scattered across the notebook and that every figure below depends on: global knitr options, output-list accumulators, package loading, helper-function sourcing, path definitions, and the metadata tables (`dt_mapping`, `dt_slims`, `dt_merged`) that are reused by several figures. Reordered here (originally these appeared in bits and pieces at the very top of the notebook, plus a handful of `library()` calls that were sprinkled right before the figure sections that first needed them, e.g. `AnnotationHub` before Figure 5's gene annotation step, `RColorBrewer`/`ComplexHeatmap`/`grid`/`ggmanh`/`ggraph`/`tidygraph` before Figure 6).

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache.rebuild = F, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3, fig.format = 'png', fig.dpi = 800, cache = TRUE)
```

### Performance at open chromatin regions

#### AR-Prostate: Median differences at open chromatin

```{r}
dt.open_chromatin <- data.table::fread("/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan/experiments/atac/enpact_score.atac_peaks.AR_Prostate.txt.gz") %>% distinct()

motif.pwc <- dt.open_chromatin %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(score ~ status) %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "status") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = 'motif')

motif.diff <- dt.open_chromatin %>%
    dplyr::group_by(status) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med = median(score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = 'status', values_from = med) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(median_diff = round(bound - unbound, 2)) %>% dplyr::mutate(group = 'motif')

open.pwc <- dt.open_chromatin %>%
    dplyr::filter(feature == 'open') %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(score ~ status) %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "status") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')

open.diff <- dt.open_chromatin %>%
    dplyr::filter(feature == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::group_by(status) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med = median(score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = 'status', values_from = med) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(median_diff = round(bound - unbound, 2)) %>% dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')


open.metrics <- dplyr::inner_join(open.diff, open.pwc, by = 'group')
motif.metrics <- dplyr::inner_join(motif.diff, motif.pwc, by = 'group')
data.diff <- dplyr::bind_rows(motif.metrics, open.metrics)
data.diff
```

```{r}
chromatin_colors <- c('open' = "#7570B3FF", 'motif' = "#A6761DFF")
status_colors <- c('bound' = "#1B9E77FF", 'unbound' = "#D95F02FF")

up <- formatC(subset(data.diff, group == 'open')$p, format = 'e', digits = 2)
labelling <- glue("p = {up}\nMedian diff. = {subset(data.diff, group == 'open')$median_diff}")
pp.boxplot.open <- dt.open_chromatin %>%
    dplyr::filter(feature == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, level = c('bound', 'unbound'))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = score, x = status, fill = status)) +
        geom_boxplot(width=0.4, color="black", outlier.shape = NA) +
        labs(x = '', y = 'AR-Prostate Binding Score', subtitle = 'Open Chromatin Regions') +
        theme_simple +
        theme(legend.position = 'none') +
        geom_text(x = 1.5, y = 7, label = labelling, color = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
        scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = status_colors)
```

#### Median differences at open chromatin

```{r}
open.atac.background <- data.table::fread(file.path("/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan", 'experiments/atac/background.atac_peaks.AR_Prostate.windows.bed')) %>%
    setnames(c('chrom', 'start', 'end', "width", 'strand', 'peak')) %>%
```

```{r}
atac_tf_pwc_results <- data.table::fread("/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan/experiments/atac/atac.bound_vs_unbound.wilcoxon_tests.dnase_atac.tsv.gz")
atac_tf_pwc_results <- atac_tf_pwc_results[complete.cases(atac_tf_pwc_results), ]

discrim_power <- atac_tf_pwc_results %>% dplyr::select(transcription_factor, tissue, median_diff, pval = p, group) %>% pivot_wider(
        names_from = group,
        values_from = c(median_diff, pval)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(discPwr = case_when(
        median_diff_open > 0 & pval_open <= 0.05 ~ 'pos_signif',
        median_diff_open < 0 & pval_open <= 0.05 ~ 'neg_signif',
        median_diff_open > 0 & pval_open > 0.05 ~ 'pos_insignif',
        median_diff_open < 0 & pval_open > 0.05 ~ 'neg_insignif'
    ), type = 'test')

head(discrim_power)
```

```{r}
pp1 <- ggplot(discrim_power, aes(x = median_diff_open, fill = ifelse(median_diff_open > 0, 'pos', 'neg'))) +
    geom_histogram(col = 'black', binwidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = 'grey', linetype = 'dashed') +
    scale_fill_manual(name = '', values = c('pos' = 'darkgreen', 'neg' = 'grey')) +
    labs(y = 'Number of TF-Tissue pairs', x = 'Median Difference\n(AR-Prostate Predicted Binding)', subtitle = 'Median Difference i.e. Bound - Unbound\nat Open Chromatin Regions') +
    theme_simple + theme(legend.position = "none")
```


#### Accessbility vs TF binding
```{r}
pred_scores <- data.table::fread(file.path('/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan', 'experiments/atac/accessibility_predicted_on_Enpact_AR_Prostate.test.tsv.gz'))
```

```{r}
binding.pwc <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(binding_score ~ binding_class) %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "binding_class") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')

accessibility.pwc <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(accessibility_score ~ binding_class) %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "binding_class") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')

binding.diff <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::group_by(binding_class) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med = median(binding_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = 'binding_class', values_from = med) %>%
    dplyr::rename(bound = `1`, unbound = `0`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(median_diff = round(bound - unbound, 2)) %>% dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')

accessibility.diff <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::group_by(binding_class) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med = median(accessibility_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = 'binding_class', values_from = med) %>%
    dplyr::rename(bound = `1`, unbound = `0`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(median_diff = round(bound - unbound, 2)) %>% dplyr::mutate(group = 'open')

binding.metrics <- dplyr::inner_join(binding.diff, binding.pwc, by = 'group')
accessibility.metrics <- dplyr::inner_join(accessibility.diff, accessibility.pwc, by = 'group')
results.diff <- dplyr::bind_rows(binding.metrics, accessibility.metrics)
```

```{r}
chromatin_colors <- c('open' = "#7570B3FF", 'motif' = "#A6761DFF")
status_colors <- c('bound' = "#1B9E77FF", 'unbound' = "#D95F02FF")

up <- formatC(subset(results.diff, `.y.` == 'binding_score')$p, format = 'e', digits = 2)
labelling <- glue("p = {up}\nMedian diff. = {subset(results.diff, `.y.` == 'binding_score')$median_diff}")
pp.boxplot.binding <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(binding_class == 1, 'bound', 'unbound')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, level = c('bound', 'unbound'))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = binding_score, x = status, fill = status)) +
        geom_boxplot(width=0.4, color="black", outlier.shape = NA) +
        labs(x = '', y = 'AR-Prostate Binding Score', subtitle = 'Open Chromatin Regions') +
        theme_simple +
        theme(legend.position = 'none') +
        geom_text(x = 1.5, y = 10, label = labelling, color = "darkgreen", size = 2, ) +
        scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = status_colors)

up <- formatC(subset(results.diff, `.y.` == 'accessibility_score')$p, format = 'e', digits = 2)
labelling <- glue("p = {up}\nMedian diff. = {subset(results.diff, `.y.` == 'accessibility_score')$median_diff}")
pp.boxplot.accessibility <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(binding_class == 1, 'bound', 'unbound')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, level = c('bound', 'unbound'))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = accessibility_score, x = status, fill = status)) +
        geom_boxplot(width=0.4, color="black", outlier.shape = NA) +
        labs(x = '', y = 'Prostate Accessibility Score', subtitle = 'Open Chromatin Regions') +
        theme_simple +
        theme(legend.position = 'none') +
        geom_text(x = 1.5, y = 10, label = labelling, color = "darkgreen", size = 2, ) +
        scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = status_colors)
```

```{r}
mydt <- pred_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(region == 'open') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(binding_class == 1, 'bound', 'unbound')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(status = factor(status, level = c('bound', 'unbound')))

ctest <- with(mydt, cor.test(binding_score, accessibility_score, method = 'pearson'))
pwrite <- ifelse(ctest$p.value == 0L, "p-value < 2.2e-16", glue("p-value: {formatC(ctest$p.value, format = 'e', digits = 2)}"))
corrlabel <- glue("Correlation: {round(ctest$estimate, 3)}\n{pwrite}")
pp.points.binding_accessibility <- ggplot(mydt, aes(x = binding_score, y = accessibility_score)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_simple +
    labs(x = "AR-Prostate Binding Score", y = 'Prostate Accessibility Score', subtitle = 'Open Chromatin Regions') +
    geom_text(label = corrlabel, col = 'darkgreen', x = -5, y = 20, size = 2.0) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey", linetype = 'dashed')
```

```{r}

    ggplot(.) + aes(x = auroc) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = 'skyblue', col = 'black') +
    labs(x = 'AUROC', y = 'Number of TF-tissue Predictors') + theme_simple +
    xlim(c(0.70,1))

auroc_hist
```

```{r}
auprc_deciles <- purrr::map(seq_along(eval_files), function(i){

})
```

### Performance (t-test) of specific models

```{r}
focus_tfs <- c('FOXA1', 'AR', 'HOXB13', 'GATA2')
tissue <- 'Prostate'
four_performance <- performance %>%
    dplyr::filter(assay %in% focus_tfs, context == tissue, type == 'test') %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, context, auroc) # dplyr::select(assay, context, auroc, low, upp)
four_performance <- four_performance %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model = paste0(assay, '_', context)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model = factor(model, levels=rev(model))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(auroc=auroc) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(model))
four_performance
```

```{r}
tfs_tissues <- as.character(four_performance$model)
tfs_tissues
```

```{r}
rundate <- '2025-04-24'
predictions <- lapply(tfs_tissues, function(each_tft){
  one_ex <- glue('/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan/data/enpact/evaluations/{each_tft}_{rundate}.logistic.test_eval.txt.gz') #|> Sys.glob()
  if(file.exists(one_ex)){
    dt <- data.table::fread(one_ex)
    return(dt)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
predictions <- Filter(Negate(is.null), predictions)
names(predictions) <- tfs_tissues
# sort by auroc
predictions <- predictions[tfs_tissues]
```

```{r}
# t-test
tstatistic <- vector(mode = 'numeric', length = length(predictions))
tpvalue <- vector(mode = 'numeric', length = length(predictions))

for(i in seq_along(predictions)){
    ttest_result <- with(predictions[[i]], t.test(TFPred_score ~ binding_class, alternative = 'less'))
    tstatistic[i] <- ttest_result$statistic
    tpvalue[i] <- ttest_result$p.value
}
```

```{r}
eval_dt <- lapply(seq_along(predictions), function(i){
    predictions[[i]]$model <- names(predictions)[i]
    return(predictions[[i]])
}) %>%
    do.call('rbind', .)
```

```{r}
eval_dt <- eval_dt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(binding_class = factor(binding_class), model=factor(model, levels = tfs_tissues))
# ttest
ttest_dt <- eval_dt %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(TFPred_score ~ binding_class) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p = ifelse(
    p < 1.e-2,
    sprintf("p = %2.1e", as.numeric(p)),
    sprintf("p = %5.4f", as.numeric(p))))
ttest_dt <- ttest_dt %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "model", dodge = 0.8)
ttest_dt
```

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}
# for AR_Prostate alone
labeller <- unique(eval_dt$model) %>% gsub('_', ' ', .)
names(labeller) <- unique(eval_dt$model)

# modify the y.position on the probability scale
sub.ttest_dt <- subset(ttest_dt, model == "AR_Prostate") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(y.position = 1.2)

boxplot_ar_prostate_performance <- eval_dt %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == 'AR_Prostate') %>%
  ggplot(.) + aes(x=model, y=probability) +
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE, linewidth=0.09, position=position_dodge(0.75), aes(fill=binding_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, alpha=0.7, outlier.shape=NA, position=position_dodge(0.75), aes(fill=binding_class)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#DAE8FC", "#E1D5E7")) +
  labs(title='', y='Probability', x='', fill = 'Binding') +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=labeller) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_simple +
  theme(legend.position =c(0.1,0.9),
    axis.text.x=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  theme() +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    sub.ttest_dt, label = "p",
    tip.length = 0, label.size = 2.5)

boxplot_ar_prostate_performance
```

```{r, plots_performance_other_models_violin-logits, fig.height = 4, fig.width=8}
  dplyr::filter(model != 'AR_Prostate') %>%
  ggplot(.) + aes(x=model, y=probability) +
  geom_violin(trim=F, linewidth=0.09, position=position_dodge(0.75), aes(fill=binding_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, alpha=0.7, outlier.shape=NA, position=position_dodge(0.75), aes(fill=binding_class)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#DAE8FC", "#E1D5E7")) +
  labs(title='', y='Probability', x='', fill = 'Binding') +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=labeller) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_simple +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    ttest_others, label = "p",
    tip.length = 0, label.size = 2.5)

# auroc_others
```

### Correlation and sign flipping at different thresholds
```{r}
fdr_cutoffs <- seq(from = 0.01, to = 1, by = 0.01)

prop_correct_sign <- purrr::map(fdr_cutoffs, function(fdr_cut){
    corr_signif <- dt_enpact_observed.cor %>% dplyr::mutate(fdr = qvalue::qvalue(pval, fdr.level = fdr_cut)$significant) %>% dplyr::filter(fdr == TRUE) %>% dplyr::pull(corr)
    tb <- table(sign(corr_signif) == 1)
    data.table(fdr_cutoff = fdr_cut, neg_corr = tb[1], pos_corr = tb[2])
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows() %>% dplyr::mutate(sum_number = neg_corr + pos_corr) %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !c(fdr_cutoff, sum_number), names_to = 'sign', values_to = 'number')  %>% dplyr::mutate(prop = (number / sum_number))

prop_correct_sign
```

```{r}
number_plot <- ggplot(subset(prop_correct_sign, sign == 'neg_corr'), aes(x = fdr_cutoff, y = sum_number)) +
    geom_col(col = 'black') + labs(x = 'FDR Cutoff', y = 'Number of Significantly Correlated ARBS', subtitle = 'Enpact vs. Observed:\nNumber of significantly correlated ARBS\nat increasing FDR stringency') + theme_simple + scale_x_reverse()

ggsave(file.path(supp_figures_directory, "SF2.fdr_vs_num_significant.png"), number_plot, width = 3500, height = 3500, dpi = 800, units = 'px')
```

```{r}
prop_plot <- prop_correct_sign %>% ggplot(aes(x = fdr_cutoff, y = prop, fill = sign)) +
    geom_col(col = 'black') +
    scale_fill_manual(name = 'Correlation Sign', values = c('neg_corr' = 'grey', 'pos_corr' = 'darkgreen'), labels = c('-', '+')) +
    scale_x_reverse() + labs(x = 'FDR Cutoff', y = 'Proportion of Significant ARBS', subtitle = 'Enpact vs. Observed:\nProportion of positively or negatively correlated\nARBS at increasing FDR stringency') + theme_simple


ggsave(file.path(supp_figures_directory, "SF2.fdr_vs_proportion_significant.png"), prop_plot, width = 4500, height = 3500, dpi = 800, units = 'px')
```

```{r}
    dplyr::rename(pvalue = spearman_pvalue, corr = spearman_r) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue))

dt_merged.null_obs <- dplyr::inner_join(cor_enp_cwas, cor_null, by = 'locus', suffix = c('.obs', '.null'))
```

```{r}
    dplyr::arrange(pvalue.obs, desc(corr.obs))

    dplyr::filter(corr.obs < 0) %>%

    dplyr::select(locus, corr.obs, pvalue.obs) %>%
```

#### Plot 12 positive correlations
```{r}
top12_escore <- t(enpact_mat)[, top12_signif_positive_cor$locus] |> t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column('locus') %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=!locus, names_to='sample', values_to='enpact_score')

top12_cscore <- t(cwas_mat)[, top12_signif_positive_cor$locus] |> t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column('locus') %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=!locus, names_to='sample', values_to='cwas_score')

top12_ect <- dplyr::inner_join(top12_escore, top12_cscore, by=c('locus' = 'locus', 'sample' = 'sample')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = top12_signif_positive_cor$locus))
top12_ect[1:5, ]
```

```{r}
usecorvalues <- top12_ect %>%
  dplyr::group_by(locus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(cor = round(as.numeric(unname(cor.test(enpact_score, cwas_score, method = 'spearman')$estimate)), 3))

gc_cortest <- top12_ect %>%
  dplyr::group_by(locus) %>%
  rstatix::cor_test(enpact_score, cwas_score, method = 'spearman') %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
    dplyr::select(-cor)

#  merge
gc_cortest <- dplyr::left_join(gc_cortest, usecorvalues, by = 'locus') %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p = ifelse(
    p < 1.e-2,
    sprintf("p = %2.1e", as.numeric(p)),
    sprintf("p = %5.4f", as.numeric(p))),
    cp = paste('Spearman r =', cor),
    label = paste(cp, p, sep = '\n')) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(cor)))
gc_cortest
```

```{r}
    geom_histogram(aes(x = merged.result$r.corr, fill = 'observed'), col = 'black', alpha = 1) +
    geom_histogram(aes(x = merged.result$r.null, fill = 'null'), col = 'black', alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = '', values = c('observed'='darkgreen', 'null'='red')) +
    theme_simple +
    labs(x = "Correlation\n(SNP-Enpact vs. CWAS top1 QTLs)", y = "Number of ARBS") +
    theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.8),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 3),          # title text size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 3),           # label text size
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),              # overall swatch box size (both dims)
        legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),            # override height only, if needed
        legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),             # override width only, if needed
        legend.key.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),           # gap between multiple keys (ggplot2 ≥3.5)
        legend.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),               # gap between legend and other elements
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))             # padding around the whole legend box

plot_pvalue <- qqcompare.ggplot(merged.result$pvalue.corr, merged.result$pvalue.null, names = c('observed', 'null')) +
    theme_simple +
    scale_color_manual(name = '', values = c('observed' = 'darkgreen', 'null' = 'red')) +
    theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.6, 0.8),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 3),          # title text size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 3),           # label text size
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),              # overall swatch box size (both dims)
        legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),            # override height only, if needed
        legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),             # override width only, if needed
        legend.key.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),           # gap between multiple keys (ggplot2 ≥3.5)
        legend.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),               # gap between legend and other elements
```

- how are these split across LD blocks?

- CWAS
```{r}
cwas_assoc <- dt_compare %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(CWAS.Z)) %>%
    tidyr::separate(locus, into = c('chrom', 'start', 'end'), sep = '_') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(c(start, end), as.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::select(chrom, start, end)
cwas_assoc |> head()
```

```{r}
# overlap with LD blocks
ldgranges <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = ldblocks$chrom, IRanges::IRanges(start = ldblocks$start, end = ldblocks$end))
cwasgranges <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = cwas_assoc$chrom, IRanges::IRanges(start = cwas_assoc$start, end = cwas_assoc$end))

ldblock_hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(query = cwasgranges, subject = ldgranges)
```

```{r}
cwas_jt <- data.table::data.table(
    ldblock = ldblocks[subjectHits(ldblock_hits), ] %>% tidyr::unite('locus', chrom:end, sep='_') %>% dplyr::pull(locus),
    arbs = cwas_assoc[queryHits(ldblock_hits), ] %>% tidyr::unite('locus', chrom:end, sep='_') %>% dplyr::pull(locus)
) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ldblock) %>%
    dplyr::tally() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chrom = sub('_.*', '', ldblock)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0('chr', c(1:22))))
```


So, we find 72 that were tested in the 5580, but they did not test 92 of these ones we found. The overlap is 41.

We can say that we find many more because they lacked to power to test exhaustively, to start with.

```{r}
    dplyr::select(locus = gene_name, TFXcan.Z = zscore, TFXcan.P = pvalue)

commonly_identified <- intersect(dt_compare[!is.na(CWAS.P)]$locus, dt_compare[!is.na(TFXcan.P)]$locus)
cwas_found_only <- setdiff(dt_compare[!is.na(CWAS.P)]$locus, commonly_identified)

dt_comp <- dplyr::inner_join(cwas_5580, xdt, by=c('locus')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(found = case_when(
            locus %in% cwas_found_only ~ 'cwas',
            locus %in% commonly_identified ~ 'both',
            .default = 'tfxcan')
    )
```

```{r}
dt_zscores <- dt_comp %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bg = case_when(
        found == 'both' ~ 'blue',
        .default = 'grey'

    dplyr::mutate(CWAS.Z = abs(CWAS.Z), TFXcan.Z = abs(TFXcan.Z)) %>%
    dplyr::select(locus, CWAS.Z, TFXcan.Z, found, bg)

# %>%
#     tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(CWAS.Z, TFXcan.Z), names_to = 'method', values_to = 'zscore')

data.table::fwrite(dt_zscores, file.path(files_directory, 'cwas_tfxcan_zscores.tsv.gz'), sep = '\t', quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T)
```

#### Functional classification of genes near exclusive Enpact-based and CWAS-based ARBS

I have decided to look at genes within 1 mb of the ARBS.

```{r}
## Load the annotation resource.
ah <- AnnotationHub(localHub=TRUE)
## Query for available H.Sapiens EnsDb databases
ahDb <- query(ah, pattern = c("Homo Sapiens", "EnsDb"))
```

```{r}
ensdb <- ah[['AH119325']] # AH119325 | Ensembl 113 EnsDb for Homo sapiens

# filter for chromosomes 1:22
ensdb <- ensembldb::addFilter(ensdb, SeqNameFilter(c(1:22)))
# filter for only protein coding genes
filtr <- GeneBiotypeFilter('protein_coding', condition = "==")
# create genes_Granges
genes_granges <- genes(ensdb, filter = filtr)
# convert to data table
dt_genes <- genes_granges %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, width, gene_name, strand) %>%
    dplyr::rename(chrom=seqnames)
```

```{r}
tfxcan_granges <- with(man.dt_tfxcan, GenomicRanges::GRanges(chrom, IRanges::IRanges(start = pos, end = pos)))
nearest_genes <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(tfxcan_granges, genes_granges, maxgap = 1000000)
nearest_genes
```

```{r}
# how many unique genes
subjectHits(nearest_genes) |> unique() |> length()

queryHits(nearest_genes) |> unique() |> length()

# 6922 genes
```

```{r}
GG <- genes_granges[subjectHits(nearest_genes), ] %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_chrom = seqnames, gene_start=start, gene_end=end, gene_name, gene_id)

TT <- man.dt_tfxcan[queryHits(nearest_genes), ] %>%
    dplyr::select(tfxcan_chrom = chrom, tfxcan_pos = pos, tfxcan_pvalue = pvalue, arbs = gene_name)
```

```{r}
arbs.nearest_genes <- dplyr::bind_cols(TT, GG) %>% dplyr::arrange(tfxcan_pvalue)
arbs.nearest_genes
```

Multiple ARBS can be near the same gene, so we need to group by gene and count the number of ARBS near each gene.
```{r}
arbs.nearest_genes %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name != "") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene_name) %>%
    dplyr::tally() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
tfxcan_exclusive_arbs <- man.dt_tfxcan %>% dplyr::filter(
    gene_name %in% (dt_compare %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(TFXcan.P) & is.na(CWAS.P)) %>% dplyr::pull(locus))
)
```

```{r}
dt.tfxcan_exclusive <- man.dt_tfxcan %>% dplyr::filter(
    gene_name %in% (dt_compare %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(TFXcan.P) & is.na(CWAS.P)) %>% dplyr::pull(locus))
) %>%
    dplyr::select(tfxcan_loci = gene_name) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(arbs.nearest_genes, by=c('tfxcan_loci' = 'arbs')) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name != "")

granges.tfxcan_exclusive <- dt.tfxcan_exclusive %>% with(., GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = tfxcan_chrom, IRanges(start = tfxcan_pos, end = tfxcan_pos)))

dt.cwas_exclusive <- man.dt_tfxcan %>% dplyr::filter(
    gene_name %in% (dt_compare %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(TFXcan.P) & !is.na(CWAS.P)) %>% dplyr::pull(locus))
) %>%
    dplyr::select(cwas_loci = gene_name) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(arbs.nearest_genes, by=c('cwas_loci' = 'arbs')) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name != "")

granges.cwas_exclusive <- dt.cwas_exclusive %>% with(., GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = tfxcan_chrom, IRanges(start = tfxcan_pos, end = tfxcan_pos)))

dt.common <- man.dt_tfxcan %>% dplyr::filter(
    gene_name %in% (dt_compare %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(TFXcan.P) & !is.na(CWAS.P)) %>% dplyr::pull(locus))
) %>%
    dplyr::select(common_loci = gene_name) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(arbs.nearest_genes, by=c('common_loci' = 'arbs')) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name != "")

granges.common <- dt.common %>% with(., GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = tfxcan_chrom, IRanges(start = tfxcan_pos, end = tfxcan_pos)))

dt.all <- arbs.nearest_genes %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name != "")
```

```{r}
# create the list of ggranges for the top.arbs

list.ggranges <- purrr::map(unique(top.dt_lzoom$gene_name), function(gene){
    ggranges <- with(
        top.dt_lzoom %>%
            dplyr::filter(gene_name == gene) %>%
            dplyr::distinct(seqnames, start, end, gene_name),
        GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = seqnames, IRanges(start = start, end = end), gene_name = gene_name))

    return(ggranges)
})

names(list.ggranges) <- unique(top.dt_lzoom$gene_name)
list.ggranges <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list.ggranges)
```

```{r}
# make the list of locus zoom plots
list.lzoomPlots <- purrr::map(names(list.ggranges), function(agene){
    # get the tfxcan results
    tfxcan_et <- top.dt_lzoom %>%
        dplyr::filter(gene_name == agene) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(arbs, zscore = TFXcan.Z, pvalue = TFXcan.P) %>%
        tidyr::separate_wider_delim(arbs, delim = '_', names = c('chrom', 'start', 'end'), cols_remove = F)

    ggranges <- list.ggranges[[agene]]
    chrom <- paste0('chr', ggranges@seqnames |> as.character())
    gstart <- start(ggranges)
    gend <- end(ggranges)
    chrom_tfxcan <- top.arbs %>%
        dplyr::filter(chrom == ggranges@seqnames |> as.character() |> as.integer(), dplyr::between(pos, gstart - 1e6, gend + 1e6)) %>%
        dplyr::select(chrom, pos, rsid=locus, start, end, pvalue = TFXcan.P) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(logP = -log10(pvalue))
    dg <- chrom_tfxcan %>% dplyr::select(chrom, pos, p=pvalue, start, end, rsid) |> as.data.frame()
    loc <- locus(data = dg, gene = agene, ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86", index_snp = intersect(dg$rsid, tfxcan_et$arbs), flank = 1e6)

    pp <- locus_ggplot(loc, filter_gene_biotype = 'protein_coding', highlight = agene, labels = "index", nudge_y = 0.05) +
        theme(text=element_text(size=9.33, colour = 'black', family = 'Helvetica'),
        axis.text = element_text(hjust = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text( hjust=0.5), legend.position="none",
        panel.background = element_rect(color = 'black'))
})

names(list.lzoomPlots) <- names(list.ggranges)
```

#### What TFs are most important across all 140 GWAS loci?

```{r}
dt_pranking <- prca_tfxcan %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tf, locus) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(acatP = ACAT::ACAT(pvalue)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(neglogP = -log10(acatP)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(locus) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(prank = rank(-neglogP, ties.method = 'average')) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(prank))

# boxplots
arrangement <- dt_pranking %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tf) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(mn = median(prank)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mn)

dt_pranking$tf <- factor(dt_pranking$tf, levels = arrangement$tf)

tfxcan_tf_pval_ranking <- dt_pranking %>%
    dplyr::filter(tf %in% arrangement$tf) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = prank, y = tf)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) + theme_simple +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = 'TFXcan ACAT pvalue ranking', x = 'Median Rank across 132 GWAS loci', y = 'Transcription Factor')
```

```{r}
wrows <- c(1:10, (nrow(shw_mat) - 10):nrow(shw_mat))

mmat <- (mmat[, -ncol(mmat), drop = FALSE])

# --- p1: TFXcan^2 heatmap ---
mmat_df <- (mmat**2) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column('row_id') %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !row_id, names_to = 'col_id', values_to = 'value')

mmat_df$col_id <- factor(mmat_df$col_id, levels = colnames(mmat))

    geom_tile(color = 'black', linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Blues"), name = expression(Z[TFXcan]^2), guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(0.1, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2, family = 'Helvetica', margin = margin(t = 1)),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2, family = 'Helvetica', margin = margin(r = 1)),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 3, family = 'Helvetica', margin = margin(b = 1)),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 3, family = 'Helvetica'),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")
    )

# --- p2: GWAS heatmap (single column) ---
g.mmat_df <- g.mmat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column('row_id') %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !row_id, names_to = 'col_id', values_to = 'value')

g.mmat_df$row_id <- factor(g.mmat_df$row_id, levels = rev(rownames(g.mmat)))
g.mmat_df$col_id <- factor(g.mmat_df$col_id, levels = colnames(g.mmat))

p2 <- ggplot(g.mmat_df, aes(x = col_id, y = row_id, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = 'black', linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "RdBu"), name = expression(Z[GWAS]), guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(0.1, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3, family = 'Helvetica', margin = margin(t = 1)),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),   # rows already labeled by p1; avoid duplicating
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 3, family = 'Helvetica', margin = margin(b = 1)),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 3, family = 'Helvetica'),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")
    )

p1 <- p1 + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0.5, r = 0.05, b = 0.1, l = 0.1))
p2 <- p2 + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0.5, r = 0.1, b = 0.1, l = 0.05))

subset_tenerife <- p1 + p2 + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(ncol(mmat), ncol(g.mmat)), guides = 'collect') &
```

```{r}

    geom_point(aes(x = 1:length(cum_pve), y = cum_pve), size = 2) +

    labs(x = 'Program', y = 'Cumulative PVE') +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, length(cum_pve), 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(round(min(cum_pve), 2), round(max(cum_pve), 2)), breaks = seq(round(min(cum_pve), 2), round(max(cum_pve), 2), by=0.01)) + theme( aspect.ratio=1)
```

## Assigning programs

###  Compute consensus of F and L matrices

I need to manually check what programs these are
```{r}
# what possible clusters are here?

nc_programs <- length(table(cluster_assignments))

pclusts <- purrr::map(1:nc_programs, function(i){
    X <- select_ks(cluster_assignments, i, yclust, samp = FALSE)
    X <- rowMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE) |> as.matrix()
    return(X)
}, .progress = TRUE) %>% setNames(paste0('Cluster_', 1:nc_programs))

prca_tfxcan_programs <- lapply(seq_along(pclusts), function(i){
   pclusts[[i]] %>%
        data.table::as.data.table(keep.rownames = TRUE) %>%
        setNames(c('tf_tissue', 'contribution')) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(contribution)) %>%
        data.table::setnames(c('tf_tissue', glue("Cluster_{i}")))
}) %>% purrr::reduce(dplyr::inner_join, by = 'tf_tissue')
```

```{r}
dt_loci_assignments <- data.table::fread(loci_assignment)
tfxcan_locus_effects <- dt_loci_assignments %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames('locus') %>%
    setNames(paste0('k', 1:ncol(.))) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column('locus')

colnames(tfxcan_locus_effects) <- gsub('k', 'Cluster_', colnames(tfxcan_locus_effects))
```

```{r}
# pclust is already averages
av_pps <- lapply(tfxcan_programs, function(each_program){
    dt <- prca_tfxcan_programs %>%
        dplyr::select(all_of(c('tf_tissue', each_program))) %>%
        setNames(c('tf_tissue', 'contribution')) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(contribution)) %>%
        head(n=10) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(contribution = round(contribution, 2))
    prcolor <- dplyr::filter(program_meta, name == each_program)$program_color
    # create gradient
    climit <- nrow(dt) + 5
    cgradient <- colorRampPalette(c(prcolor, "white"))(climit)
    cgradient <- cgradient[1:(nrow(dt))]

    dt %>%
        tidyr::separate(tf_tissue, c('tf', 'tissue'), sep = '_', remove = F) %>%
        ggplot(aes(y = reorder(tf_tissue, -contribution), x = contribution, fill = tf_tissue, group = tissue)) +
        theme_simple +
        geom_col(col = 'black', width = 1, fill = cgradient, linewidth = 0.1) +
        labs(x = 'Consensus Contribution', y = 'Driver', subtitle = each_program) +
        scale_y_discrete(
                labels = function(x) {data.table::tstrsplit(x, "_")[[1]]},
                limits = rev, expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
        ggplot2::guides(fill = "none") +
        scale_fill_discrete(drop=F) +
        geom_text(aes(label = tissue, group = tf_tissue), size = 0.8, position = position_identity(), hjust = 1.5) +
        theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 1.5), text = element_text(size = 2), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 2))

})

names(av_pps) <- tfxcan_programs
```

```{r}
combined_pps <- purrr::map_dfr(tfxcan_programs, function(each_program){
    dt <- prca_tfxcan_programs %>%
        dplyr::select(all_of(c('tf_tissue', each_program))) %>%
        setNames(c('tf_tissue', 'contribution')) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(contribution)) %>%

        dplyr::mutate(contribution = round(contribution, 2))

    prcolor <- dplyr::filter(program_meta, name == each_program)$program_color
    climit <- nrow(dt) + 5

})

# strip tidytext's "___program" suffix before extracting the tf label
```

```{r}
test_groups <- c('is_liver', 'is_bone_marrow', 'is_blood', 'is_colon', 'is_ctcf', 'is_rest', 'is_prostate', 'is_breast', 'is_prostate_or_breast', 'is_nuclear_receptor', 'is_prca_tf')
```

```{r}
cluster_ttests <- purrr::map(names(pclusts), function(each_cluster){
    dt <- pclusts[[each_cluster]] %>% as.data.table(keep.rownames = 'tf_tissue') %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(meta_assignments, by = c('tf_tissue' = 'tf_tissue')) %>%
        dplyr::rename(contribution = V1) %>%
        as.data.table()

    test <- purrr::map(test_groups, function(each_group){
        test <- t.test(dt$contribution ~ dt[[each_group]])
        return(test$p.value)
    })
    test <- as.numeric(test)
    names(test) <- test_groups
    return(test)
}) %>%
    do.call('rbind', .)

rownames(cluster_ttests) <- names(pclusts)
cluster_ttests <- -log10(cluster_ttests)
cluster_ttests
```

```{r}
# assign each locus to a program by the maximum
loci_designation <- apply(gwas_clusters, 1, function(x){
        data.table(name = colnames(gwas_clusters)[which.max(x)],
            contribution = max(x))
    }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(locus = rownames(gwas_clusters)) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(locus)
```

```{r}
# Add 'none' to colormap

colormap <- c(colormap, 'none_odd' = "#BEBEBE80", 'none_even' = '#4D4D4D')

chrom_lengths <- get_chrom_lengths('hg38')
xmax <- get_total_length(chrom_lengths)
x_breaks <- get_x_breaks(chrom_lengths)
```

```{r}
mandt <- data.table::fread(file.path(files_directory, "tfxcan.prca_gwas.txt.gz"), sep = '\t', quote = F, header = T) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(cluster, name, color, designated_program, contribution))

mandt <- mandt %>% dplyr::left_join(loci_designation, by = c('snp' = 'locus'))
mandt[1:5, ]
# prca.gwas.summary_stats <- data.table::fread(file.path('/beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan-snakemake/data/sumstats', "prostate_cancer_risk.liftover.logistic.assoc.tsv.gz"), sep = '\t', quote = F, header = T)
```

```{r}
ppdt <- mandt %>%
    dplyr::rename(chrom = chromosome, pos = position, y = log10pval) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name = as.character(name)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(name) ~ 'none',
        TRUE ~ name
    )) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name_chrom = dplyr::case_when(
        name == 'none' & chrom %in% seq(1, 22, by = 2) ~ 'none_odd',
        name == 'none' & chrom %in% seq(0, 22, by = 2) ~ 'none_even',
        TRUE ~ name
    )) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chrom = paste0('chr', chrom), fill = program_color) %>%
    add_cumulative_pos('hg38') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name_chrom = factor(name_chrom, levels = names(colormap)), contribution = ifelse(is.na(contribution), 0, contribution))

chromosome_levels <- paste0('chr', seq(1, 22))

chrom_breaks <- ppdt %>%
    dplyr::group_by(chrom) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(center = mean(cumulative_pos)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(match(chrom, chromosome_levels)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chrom = gsub('chr', '', chrom)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(chrom = as.numeric(chrom))

x_breaks <- setNames(chrom_breaks$center, chrom_breaks$chrom)
```


```{r}
# split each into a graph
graph_objects <- split(dt.ppi, dt.ppi$program) %>% purrr::map(as_tbl_graph)

gnames <- names(graph_objects)

# add the nodes that are non interacting
graph_objects <- purrr::map(names(graph_objects), function(gg){
    if(gg %in% colnames(dt_nonInteractors)){
        addthis <- dt_nonInteractors %>% pull(.data[[gg]]) %>% unique()
        ggg <- graph_objects[[gg]] %>% igraph::add_vertices(nv = length(addthis), name = addthis)
        return(ggg)
    }
    return(graph_objects[[gg]])

})
```

#### Using a null distribution

Here, I ran 10000 iterations using the top 15 TF-tissue pairs with the background being the 204 TFXcan TFs.
```{r}
null_interactions.list <- readRDS(file.path(tfxcan_project_directory, "experiments/validation/STRINGPPI.cistromeDB.null_interactions.rds"))

# hacky but I like it
names(null_interactions.list)[names(null_interactions.list) %in% c("Hormone receptors", "Bone marrow")] <- stringi::stri_trans_totitle(names(null_interactions.list)[names(null_interactions.list) %in% c("Hormone receptors", "Bone marrow")])

lapply(null_interactions.list, dim) %>% as.data.table()
```

```{r}
# this was calculated earlier; observed interactions computed from the STRING PPI API
dt_enrichment <- data.table::fread(file.path(tfxcan_project_directory, "experiments/validation/tfxcan_programs.enrichment.tsv")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(program = case_when(
        program %in% c("Bone marrow", "Hormone receptors") ~ stringi::stri_trans_totitle(program),
       TRUE ~ as.character(program)
    ))
dt_enrichment
```

```{r}
# calculate probability of the observed value or more
probs_events <- purrr::map(names(null_interactions.list), function(pp){
    dt.null <- null_interactions.list[[pp]]
    if(!is.null(dt.null)){
        obs_n_interactions <- dt_enrichment %>% dplyr::filter(program == pp) %>% dplyr::pull(interactions)
        null_dist <- dt.null$null_n_interactions
        prob_k <- sum(null_dist >= obs_n_interactions) / length(null_dist)
        return(prob_k)
    }
})
names(probs_events) <- names(null_interactions.list)
as.data.table(probs_events)
```

Plot the graphs

```{r}
ppi_graphs <- purrr::map(names(main_graphs), function(pname){
    pdt <- dt_enrichment %>% dplyr::filter(program == pname)
    nproteins <- igraph::gorder(main_graphs[[pname]])
    pwrite <- ifelse(pdt$pvalue %in% c(0L, 2.22e-16), "p < 2.22e-16", glue("p = {pdt$pvalue}"))

    heading <- glue("{pdt$program}\nTranscription factors: {nproteins}\nInteractions: {pdt$interactions}")

    edge_color <- program_meta %>% dplyr::filter(name == pname) %>% dplyr::pull(program_color)

    ggraph(main_graphs[[pname]], layout = 'stress') +
        geom_edge_link(color = 'white') +
        geom_node_point(size = 0.5, color = edge_color) +
        geom_node_text(
            aes(label = name),
            repel = TRUE,
            size = 0.5,
            seed = 42,
            segment.color = NA,
            force = 0.2,          # weaker repulsion between overlapping labels (less push away)
            force_pull = 3,       # stronger pull back toward the label's own point
            box.padding = 0.05,   # minimum gap around each label's bounding box
            point.padding = 0,    # minimum gap between label and its point (0 = allowed to touch)
            max.overlaps = Inf,    # don't drop labels instead of moving them — force closeness instead
        ) +
        geom_edge_link(aes(width = score), color = 'grey', alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 1)/10, name="STRING\nPPI score", guide = guide_legend(
            title.theme = element_text(size = 1.5, family = 'Helvetica'),
            label.theme = element_text(size = 1, family = 'Helvetica')
        )) +
        labs(subtitle = heading) +
        theme_simple_graph
})

ppi_graphs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ppi_graphs)
```

```{r}
pp_list <- purrr::map(names(main_histograms), function(pp){
    dt.null <- main_histograms[[pp]]
    if(!is.null(dt.null)){
        obs_n_interactions <- dt_enrichment %>% dplyr::filter(program == pp) %>% dplyr::pull(interactions)
        p_val <- probs_events[[pp]]
        #subt <- glue::glue("Interactions: {obs_n_interactions}\np-value: {p_val}")
        subt <- glue::glue("p-value: {p_val}")

        po <- ggplot() +
            geom_histogram(aes(x = dt.null$null_n_interactions, color = 'exp_int'), binwidth = 5, linewidth = 0.01) +
            geom_vline(aes(xintercept = obs_n_interactions, color = 'obs_int'), linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.1) + theme_simple +
                labs(x = 'Number of Interactions', y = 'Number of Null Replicates', subtitle = subt) +
                scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c(obs_int = "red", exp_int = 'black'), labels = c(obs_int = 'Observed interactions', exp_int = 'Null distribution')) +
            theme(
                legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", linewidth = 0.1),
                legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = 'transparent')) +
                theme_simple_small

            return(po)
    } else {
        return(NULL)
    }
})
names(pp_list) <- names(main_histograms)
pp_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pp_list)
```

```{r}
    dplyr::filter(category %in% c("Component", 'Function', 'KEGG', "WikiPathways", "Process", 'RCTM')) %>%
```

```{r}
enrichment_splits <- enrichment_results %>% split(.$program)

gene_count_limits <- range(enrichment_results$number_of_genes, na.rm = TRUE)

enrichment_plots <- purrr::map(names(enrichment_splits), function(pname){
    ep <- enrichment_results %>%
        dplyr::filter(program == pname, fdr <= 0.05) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(fdr) %>%
        dplyr::select(category, program, description, number_of_genes, fdr, p_value, term, neglogP) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(description) %>% dplyr::slice_min(p_value) %>% ungroup()

    pp <- ggplot(ep, aes(x = neglogP, y = reorder(description, neglogP))) +
        geom_point(aes(size = number_of_genes)) +
        geom_segment(aes(xend=0, yend=description), linewidth = 0.2) +
        theme_simple_small +
        guides(size = guide_legend(title = 'Gene Count')) +
        labs(x = expression(-log[10]*"P"), y = 'Term', subtitle = unique(pname)) +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.1, 0.9), limits = gene_count_limits)

    return(pp)

}, .progress = TRUE)

names(enrichment_plots) <- names(enrichment_splits)
```

```{r}
sheet_headers <- c(
    "Annotations of Enformer epigenomic features",

    "AR-Prostate feature ablation performance",
    "A list of established pioneer factors from Mayran and Drouin, 2018 (doi: 10.1074/jbc.R117.001232)",
    "AR–Prostate performance using random- or motif-training sites",
    "Enpact’s TF–tissue performance at accessibility sites",
    "Correlation test of predicted AR-Prostate binding scores with observed peak intensities for Baca' CWAS individuals. Both Enpact and CWAS predictors were tested",
    "Correlation test of AR binding predictions in prostate tissues of (1) Enpact vs. CWAS top1 models, and (2) SNP-Enpact vs. CWAS top1 QTL models",
    "Results of association of AR binding in prostate tissues with Prostate cancer risk",
    "Z-scores and p values of androgen receptor binding sites (ARBS) identified by Enpact and CWAS",
    "Over-representation analysis of genes near 44 TFXcan distinctly-identified ARBS",
    "TFXcan results of association of the binding of 700 TF-tissue pairs with Prostate cancer risk",
    "Contribution of TF-tissue pair to consensus programs",
    "Over-representation analysis of genes near top 15 TFs for each TFXcan PrCa program",
    "Effect of GWAS SNPs on consensus programs",
    "Summary information of TFs, tissues, and experiments from the Cistrome Database used to train TF/tissue predictors",
    "R packages used in this analysis and their versions"
)
```

```{r}
if(length(sheet_headers) == length(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES)){
    names(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES) <- sheet_headers
} else {
    print("ERROR - NAMES DON'T MATCH SUPPLEMENTARY TABLES")
    names(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES) <- glue::glue("Suppl. Table {1:length(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES)}")
}
```

```{r}
lapply(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES, dim)
```

```{r}
dt_readme <- data.table::data.table(Information = sheet_headers) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Table = paste('Table S', 1:nrow(.), sep = '')) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(Table, Information)
```

```{r, eval = T, fig.height = 6}
usestyle <- createStyle('Helvetica', 7)
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = "README")
writeData(wb, sheet = 'README', x = "This file contains tables reported in the TFXcan paper.\nBelow are the list of these tables and what data/information/results they contain.", startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
writeDataTable(wb, sheet = "README", x = dt_readme, rowNames = F, colNames = T, startCol = 1, startRow = 3, withFilter = FALSE)

#write out tables
for (i in seq_along(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES)) {
    shname <- paste0('Table S', i)
    headname <- as.character(glue::glue("{shname}: {names(SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES)[i]}"))
    print(headname)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = shname)
    writeData(wb, sheet = shname, x = headname, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
    writeDataTable(wb, shname, x = SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLES[[i]], startRow = 2, startCol = 1, withFilter = FALSE)
}

# Save workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(files_directory, 'enpact-paper.supplementary_tables.xlsx'), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
knitr::knit_exit()
```

## Code below `knitr::knit_exit()` (never executed in the original notebook)

The original notebook called `knitr::knit_exit()` right after building the supplementary-tables workbook (see the end of the "SUPPLEMENTARY TABLES" section above), which stops knitr from rendering anything past that point. Everything below this point in the original `.qmd` file is therefore dead in the sense that it never runs during a real render — some of it is itself commented out, and some of it is live-looking R code that references objects that either were already freed earlier (e.g. `FIGURE_3`, `enpact_mat`, `gt_mat`) or were only ever defined inside other still-commented-out chunks (e.g. `pdt` with an `enpact_signif` column). It is preserved here verbatim, in its original relative order, since it documents an alternate/unfinished extension of Figure 3 (Enpact vs. directly observed peak intensity, as opposed to vs. CWAS) plus some end-of-session scratch exploration.

### "Examples" — Enpact vs directly observed peak intensity (unfinished extension of Figure 3)
This block builds a `top12_signif_diff` example panel from a `pdt` object that is never actually created in this notebook (its only definition lives in the still-commented-out "multiple testing correction" chunk earlier in Figure 3), and reloads `enpact_mat`/`gt_mat`, both of which were freed earlier. It would not run even without the `knitr::knit_exit()` above. It ends by assigning a `cherrypicked_scatterplot_enpact_observed` panel to `FIGURE_3$cherrypicked_scatterplot_enpact_observed`, but `FIGURE_3` itself was already `rm()`'d after Figure 3 was assembled, so this never made it into the final figure.

```{r}
top12_signif_diff <- pdt %>%
    dplyr::filter(enpact_signif == TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pval.enpact) %>%
    dplyr::select(locus, pval=pval.enpact) %>%

print(top12_signif_diff)
```

```{r}
top12_escore <- t(enpact_mat)[, top12_signif_diff$locus] |> t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column('locus') %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=!locus, names_to='sample', values_to='enpact_score')

top12_gscore <- t(gt_mat)[, top12_signif_diff$locus] |> t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column('locus') %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=!locus, names_to='sample', values_to='observed_binding')

top12_ect <- dplyr::inner_join(top12_escore, top12_gscore, by=c('locus' = 'locus', 'sample' = 'sample')) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = top12_signif_diff$locus))
top12_ect[1:5, ]
```

```{r}
gc_cortest <- top12_ect %>%
  dplyr::group_by(locus) %>%
  rstatix::cor_test(enpact_score, observed_binding, method = 'spearman') %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p = ifelse(
    p < 1.e-2,
    sprintf("p = %2.1e", as.numeric(p)),
    sprintf("p = %5.4f", as.numeric(p))))
gc_cortest
```

```{r}
jjp <- purrr::map(gc_cortest$locus, function(ll){
    pri <- gc_cortest %>% dplyr::filter(locus == ll)
    pri <- glue::glue("{ll}\ncorr = {pri$cor}\n{pri$p}")
    top12_ect %>%
        dplyr::filter(locus == ll) %>%
        ggplot(aes(y=enpact_score, x = observed_binding)) +
        geom_point(colour = "grey50") +
        labs(subtitle=pri, y='Enpact Score', x='Observed Binding (Peak Intensity)') +
        theme_simple +
        guides(fill="none")

})


scatterplot_top12_enpact_observed <- patchwork::wrap_plots(jjp, ncol = 4)

ggsave(file.path(figures_directory, "SF2.top12_enpact_observed.png"), scatterplot_top12_enpact_observed, width = 8000, height = 6000, units = 'px', dpi = 800)
```

```{r, pos-cor-enpact-observed-probs}
cherrypicked_scatterplot_enpact_observed <- ht %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=probability, x = observed_binding)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = observed_binding), width=0.7, colour = "grey50", position = position_dodge(0.03)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = observed_binding), colour = "grey50", width = 0.05, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x='Observed Binding', y = 'Probability', subtitle=glue("Observed vs. predicted binding \nat {tname}")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D0DFE6FF", "#E1D5E7")) +
    theme_simple +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    geom_text(data=tt, mapping=aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = p), hjust = -1.5, vjust = 2, lineheight = 1, size = 2.5, color = 'black')

cherrypicked_scatterplot_enpact_observed
```
